# Property keys the GH #164 properties panel may write (og 14 Q5 follow-up).
# Shared by src/editor/editablePropertyKeys.test.ts (the TypeScript validator
# and every TypeScript reader) and crates/tine-core/src/logbook.rs tests (the
# Rust readers `doc::parse_property_line` and `logbook::is_md_property_line`).
# `+key` must be accepted and read back by every reader; `-key` must be refused
# by the panel because at least one Tine reader would not find it again.
# The rule: Unicode letters, marks and numbers, plus `_`, `.`, `/` and `-`.
+status
+Status
+owner
+a1
+1
+_
+-
+my-key
+my_key
+ABC-def_09
+x-y_z
+klíč
+日本
+é
+a/b
+a.b
+logseq.order-list-type
-
-a b
-a:b
-a::b
-#tag
-a'b
-a+b
-[[x]]
- a
-a
